title: Film Reel Phantom
description: A surreal scene inside a decaying, red-walled room with peeling paint and a checkered floor. A woman in a vintage military-style uniform and cap stands inside an ornate golden picture frame, holding a film reel, while a large film strip with horse images and a clock winds across the foreground; behind her are a telescope, vintage film projector casting light, and a stormy night sky visible through an arched window and an open wall revealing a silhouetted figure.
prompt: Surreal cinematic painting of a decaying room with peeling red walls and checkered floor. A stern woman in dark 1940s military uniform and cap stands inside a large golden picture frame holding a film canister. A film strip with horses and clock motifs winds through the foreground. Vintage film projector beams light across the scene, a brass telescope points at a starry night sky through an arched window, while a stormy exterior reveals a silhouetted figure. Moody, atmospheric, detailed textures.
